policy: Photo candidates are not approved fixtures. source_sha256 is reserved for a provenance/rights-approved original; file_bytes_sha256 is only the exact current repository byte digest. Host setups are descriptive; no fabricated runtime image, model result, or live credential data.

inputs.label: 清晰横向鱼体
inputs.required_scene: Sharp, well-lit, fully visible fish body approximately horizontal in a full-resolution natural photo; no UI overlay/watermark/identifiable bystander.
inputs.source_type: REPOSITORY_PHOTO_CANDIDATE; duplicate copies, one content identity
inputs.source_authorization: UNVERIFIED: rights, subject release, source/author and redistribution permission absent; observed image contains an identifiable person and platform watermark.
inputs.expected_quality_branch: Observe the actual quality gate; no predetermined result.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: Approved image is passed through actual normalization, Detector, Crop and Classifier for gallery/fixture scope; never treat this as CameraX full-device capture.
inputs.expected_result_branch: Record actual model terminal result. No forced HIGH/species label.
inputs.asset_status: CANDIDATE_REVIEW; scene mismatch for horizontal requirement (visible fish is vertical, person present, watermark); not approved.
inputs.missing_reason: Candidate does not meet target scene and provenance/privacy approval is missing.
inputs.remediation_plan: Acquire rights-cleared original with subject release and remove no watermark by editing existing asset; provide new authorized original and provenance. No alteration of this candidate.
inputs.model_version_dependency: Exact detector/classifier artifact SHA and preprocessing contract must be captured at execution; not frozen in current manifest.

inputs.label: 纵向鱼体
inputs.required_scene: Full fish body framed vertically with head and tail inside image; sharp enough for model inspection; source and capture context recorded.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: Normalize orientation/size then run real Detector/Crop/Classifier only after fixture approval.
inputs.expected_result_branch: Actual model branch; no predetermined species/confidence.
inputs.missing_reason: No approved full-resolution vertical fish test image.
inputs.remediation_plan: Acquire rights-cleared full-resolution vertical image; retain original bytes, source consent and capture metadata.

inputs.label: 鱼体部分出框
inputs.required_scene: Fish body intentionally intersects an image boundary (head/tail or side clipped) with annotated crop/framing description; still a decodable full-resolution photo.
inputs.expected_quality_branch: Actual detector/quality-gate response; annotation only describes input geometry.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: Run actual pipeline and inspect bbox clipping/crop behavior; do not force NO_FISH or INVALID.
inputs.expected_result_branch: Actual output; no fixed result implied by the scene label.
inputs.missing_reason: No rights-cleared partial-frame photo with scene annotation.
inputs.remediation_plan: Acquire original plus non-destructive annotation manifest; approve labels independently from model output.
inputs.model_version_dependency: Exact detector/classifier artifact and crop contract at execution.

inputs.label: 低光夜拍
inputs.required_scene: Genuinely low-light/night scene with complex background, documented capture conditions, visible fish target, full-resolution original.
inputs.source_authorization: UNVERIFIED: provenance, subject/privacy and redistribution rights absent; observed watermark/platform ID.
inputs.expected_quality_branch: Actual gate response only; do not infer INVALID from night scene.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: After approval, actual Detector/Crop/Classifier; record flash/exposure and camera/gallery origin.
inputs.expected_result_branch: Record real terminal output without assuming a species/confidence.
inputs.asset_status: CANDIDATE_REVIEW; plausible low-light/vertical fish scene, but not approved; includes watermark.
inputs.missing_reason: No source and rights approval; source profile/scene annotation incomplete.
inputs.remediation_plan: Acquire source/license/subject evidence and capture metadata, or obtain a new rights-cleared equivalent; do not crop/re-encode candidate.
inputs.model_version_dependency: Exact model and preprocessing SHA plus low-light capture metadata.

inputs.label: 真实无鱼照片
inputs.required_scene: Real, decodable outdoor/indoor scene with no fish, non-empty natural background and reviewable source; avoid synthetic blank canvas.
inputs.expected_quality_branch: Must record actual model quality/detector behavior.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: Run actual production Detector and quality gate. Do not substitute RESP-NO_FISH or hard-code expected model response.
inputs.expected_result_branch: Target scenario is NO_FISH only if actual product output is NO_FISH; otherwise record actual output and leave target unsatisfied.
inputs.missing_reason: No rights-cleared real no-fish photo and verified model behavior.
inputs.remediation_plan: Acquire natural no-fish original with provenance/rights, independent scene annotation, then run actual model qualification before approving expected branch.
inputs.model_version_dependency: Exact model SHA and inference configuration; outcome stability must be measured, not asserted.

inputs.label: 严重模糊图片
inputs.required_scene: Full-resolution photo with objectively documented focus/motion blur level and a sharp control from same acquisition where possible; fish may be present.
inputs.expected_quality_branch: No frozen blur threshold or dedicated blur metric found in current implementation; parameter/contract review required.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: Run actual Detector and current quality gate; observe only. Do not label INVALID by input filename/human opinion.
inputs.expected_result_branch: INVALID only when actual output and actual reason meet the Frozen Result contract; otherwise record actual outcome.
inputs.missing_reason: No approved blur photo; implementation audit found geometry/eligibility gate but no standalone blur metric/threshold contract.
inputs.remediation_plan: Define blur capture/measurement protocol and decision owner; obtain rights-cleared sample(s); qualify actual model output without forced responses.
inputs.model_version_dependency: Exact model/gate implementation SHA and any subsequently approved blur contract.

inputs.label: 包含 EXIF 旋转的图片
inputs.required_scene: Original JPEG with EXIF Orientation 6 or 8, raw pixel dimensions and orientation metadata preserved; define expected upright normalized geometry.
inputs.exif_orientation: Required future input: 6 or 8, exact original tag captured before decode.
inputs.expected_quality_branch: Orientation normalization should yield correct upright image before detection; output/result still model-dependent.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: Use original encoded bytes through normalization path; assert transformed pixel geometry and metadata handling.
inputs.expected_result_branch: Actual model output; orientation correctness is the target, not a predetermined fish result.
inputs.missing_reason: No EXIF-rotated original source asset found.
inputs.remediation_plan: Acquire rights-cleared original preserving EXIF; freeze original bytes, dimensions, EXIF tag and upright reference, without re-encoding.
inputs.model_version_dependency: Exact image normalization implementation and model artifact at execution.

inputs.label: 损坏或不可解码文件
inputs.required_scene: Future non-decodable byte fixture: define immutable bytes, length, media type/name and expected decoder error class; no image content assumed.
inputs.source_authorization: No image source; a minimal synthetic malformed-byte fixture may be authored later under an approved test-only data process.
inputs.expected_quality_branch: Decoder failure before detector; must not be reclassified as no-fish or image-quality INVALID unless explicit contract says so.
inputs.expected_pipeline_behavior: Deterministic decode failure, release partial buffers/files, show recoverable technical/capture error per approved failure copy.
inputs.missing_reason: Bytes were intentionally not generated in this specification-only phase.
inputs.remediation_plan: Implement later in approved test implementation phase as immutable malformed bytes with digest, schema, and decoder-version evidence.
inputs.model_version_dependency: Decoder implementation/API level; no model call expected.

image_inventory_scope.scope: Repository tree on docs/recognition-main-flow-spec-v1; raster suffixes png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif/bmp/tif/tiff; read-only inventory. No separate authorized asset directory was configured or supplied.
image_inventory_scope.sha_semantics: file_bytes_sha256 hashes the exact present repository file bytes; it is not source provenance, rights approval or Git Blob SHA. source_sha256 is intentionally null until approved.
